description: Source code for MDnsCache class managing mDNS records, including cache lookup, update, cleanup, and record expiration logic.

classes.name: MDnsCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of mDNS records with methods for lookup, update, cleanup, and record expiration.

classes.name: MDnsCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a key for identifying mDNS records in the cache, based on type, name, and optional field.

methods.name: LookupKey
methods.description: Finds a record in the cache by key.

methods.name: UpdateDnsRecord
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new or changed DNS record.

methods.name: CleanupRecords
methods.description: Removes expired or overfilled records from the cache.

methods.name: FindDnsRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all records matching a given type and name.

methods.name: RemoveRecord
methods.description: Removes a specific record from the cache.

methods.name: IsCacheOverfilled
methods.description: Checks if the cache exceeds its entry limit.

methods.name: GetOptionalFieldForRecord
methods.description: Returns the optional field for a record, e.g., ptrdomain for PTR records.

methods.name: GetEffectiveExpiration
methods.description: Calculates the expiration time for a record based on its TTL.
